```plato

// The roots of a real polynomial. RealRoots lists real roots in ascending
// order with multiplicity; ComplexRoots lists the strictly complex roots,
// one representative per conjugate pair (positive imaginary part).
type PolynomialRoots
    implements IValue
{
    RealRoots: Array<Number>;
    ComplexRoots: Array<Complex>;
}
```
